personalRepo.description: Path to your personal agents repo (its .rulesync/ folder is synced after the company one). ~ is expanded.

reposRoot.description: Folder containing your project repos. Every repo directly inside it with a .rulesync/ folder is synced. ~ is expanded.

globalDir.description: Folder in the company and personal repos holding the global sources (<globalDir>/.rulesync/ and <globalDir>/rulesync.jsonc). A repo's root .rulesync/ is project-level for that repo only.

global.description: Agents (rulesync targets) and features for the user-level configuration.

projects.description: Agents (rulesync targets) and features for project repos without their own rulesync.jsonc.

marker.description: Text every source rule and SKILL.md must contain, so generated files can be told apart from hand-written ones.

targets.description: Maps a rulesync target (e.g. claudecode, copilot) to the features generated for it.
